verdict.rationale: Founder Law's pricing page says spouses and children can be added to the primary package at a standardized flat rate, so dependents are documented as part of the service as a paid add-on. It does not name specific dependent visa categories or address dependent work authorization. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of O-3 and H-4 dependent petitions, documentation of spousal work authorization (e.g., H-4 EAD or L-2/E-3 spouse work rights), the actual dependent pricing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, dependent visas for my spouse and children (O-3, H-4, and work authorization where it exists) are documented as part of the service

citations.quote: Dependents such as a spouse or children are added to your primary legal package at a standardized, flat rate to ensure your entire transition is seamless.
startup founders can obtain up to a 30-month immigration status called “Parole” to live in the U.S. with their families and scale their startup.
